creator: Alexander Terp
description: Raised 2026-10-07. The pane menus now show a refused rename, hide, show or quiet in a sheet (ConfirmSheet.tell). Rename Tab still drops its response, so a refused tab rename (an older daemon, a gone machine) closes the sheet with nothing said. Tab names have no uniqueness rule, so it is rarer, not impossible.
title: Rename Tab discards a refusal, like the pane menus did
